_readme: Default commercial policy for CustomerOps (COPS-08). Seed data for the versioned admin config: each top-level section is the default of the admin config kind of the same name (key: default), and an Admin edits it from there without a deploy. No code contains these numbers. After editing this file run: node scripts/sync-cops-commercial-policy.mjs. Source: Aditya's COPS-08 kickoff decisions, 2026-10-13. Amounts are benchmark defaults, not margins; Finance reviews before launch.
_fixed_rules: These are behaviours of the code, not settings, so they are not in the editable config.
Every matching approval rule applies and the deal needs every approver named by any of them.
A material change to a proposal voids approvals already given.
The executive approver slot is decided by a workspace Admin.
Data is never deleted because a payment failed. A successful payment restores access before the account is closed.
Currency is set per account, locked once a proposal is sent, and never converted.
A seat change takes effect on the next billing cycle; there is no immediate proration.
_open: Contract-value thresholds for EUR, GBP and INR are taken from Aditya's file on develop (commit 4d408a70).

free_credits: provisional thresholds by credit count, set by engineering on 2026-10-13. Aditya's file instead has 'complimentary value over 10% of TCV needs the Sales Manager'. That needs a money value per credit, which is a Finance question; until it is answered the count rule stands.
price_book EUR, GBP and INR are suggestions, not benchmarked.
This file and Aditya's file on develop have the same path and different shapes. This one is shaped like the admin config kinds the code reads. The two must be reconciled before this branch merges.

approval_policy._readme: A band matches a value over `over` and at most `up_to` (null: no upper limit). So a 10% discount needs no approval and 10.01% needs the Sales Manager.

dunning_policy._readme: Day 0 is the first failed charge. Each stage runs from its day until the next one starts: past due (full access, reminders, provider retries), restricted (no new credit use, enrichment runs or outreach sends; login and payment still work), suspended (data retained, login goes to the billing page only), closed (per the retention policy).

price_book._readme: Per seat, per month, on annual billing, in minor units. Month-to-month billing adds the surcharge.
